title: Yellow Mech Boy Poses
description: Three views of a young male character in a black and yellow robotic mech suit with exposed mechanical joints and dripping yellow substance. Left shows him standing aggressively with fists raised, middle shows him upside down in mid-air, right shows him lying defeated on the ground.
